name: Albert D. Watson
bio: Albert Durrant Watson (1859–1926) was a Toronto physician who wrote verse and took an interest in astronomy and psychical research.
The poems given here are taken from The Oxford Book of Canadian Verse, chosen by Wilfred Campbell (Toronto: Oxford University Press, 1913).

poems.title: One Consciousness
poems.author: Albert D. Watson
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Canadian Verse (1913)
poems.text:
One consciousness is all that is or evermore can be :
Are not the billows of the world one all-embracing sea ?
With The Eternal I am one, and only thus am free.
I rise superior to fate ; I challenge fear, I forfeit ease.
I stand heroic and elate, and strong amid th' eternities !
